operations.description: Jobs can be canceled at any time but be aware that if a job already started, changes done by this one won't be reverted. For example, if you created a job to close 10k tickets and you cancel it at some point, these closed tickets won't be reopened.

operations.name: create_job
operations.description: Create a job and schedule its execution. Jobs are processed asynchronously, meaning that once a job is created, it will run in background on Gorgias's servers. According to the type and size of the task, a job can take a few minutes or several hours to be executed. You can use our API to check the status of the job.

operations.description:

  - not send it if the attribute `sent_datetime` is filled.
  If you import a message that was already sent, make sure to set this value.

  - add it to the ticket as an internal note if you specified this channel.

operations.name: update_ticket_custom_fields
operations.description:
Replace the custom field values for a ticket.

**Important — replace-all semantics:** The request body must contain
*all* custom field values you want the ticket to have. Any field that
currently has a value on the ticket but is **not included** in the
request body will be deleted.

Some system-managed fields (e.g. *AI Agent Outcome*, *AI Intent*)
can only be deleted by Gorgias internal apps.

**Safe pattern:** fetch the current values with
`GET /api/tickets/{ticket_id}/custom-fields`, merge your changes, and
send the full list back.
